title: Software Code Standard
description: First checklist in the engine. Scaffolded catalog — no real Excel template file is present in this repository.

template_gap.note: No Software Code Standard .xlsx/.xlsm was found under templates/excel/ or elsewhere in the repo. This JSON is a faithful versioned checklist_definitions/items + cell-mapping scaffold for Phase 4 evaluation. Do not assume additional template workbooks exist as files. When a real template is supplied, set excel_template_path and regenerate cell maps from that workbook.

items.prompt: Does every source file include a file header comment with copyright or ownership notice?

subchecks.text: Header block present near top of each file unit

items.acceptance_criteria: YES only if all scanned code units satisfy both subchecks.

items.prompt: Are TODO/FIXME markers absent from all production source pages/units?

subchecks.text: No TODO/FIXME/XXX markers in any unit

items.acceptance_criteria: YES if full scan finds zero markers; NO if any found; missing search is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE not NO.

items.prompt: Is the coding standard document itself applicable and cited for this software baseline?
items.applicability: NA if project explicitly excludes software code deliverables.

subchecks.text: If NA, inapplicability rationale must be present

items.acceptance_criteria: NA requires explicit inapplicability rationale in comment; otherwise evaluate presence of coding-standard citation in document text.

items.prompt: Does the design/code documentation adequately describe naming conventions used in the software?
items.acceptance_criteria: YES requires all subchecks supported by cited evidence IDs; model confidence alone is not approval.

items.prompt: Are related DO-178C (or project coding) standard clauses available and consistent for this review?

subchecks.text: Dependent reference is verified or user-selected

items.acceptance_criteria: If dependent reference missing/ambiguous → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (not NO). Critical reference errors surfaced on item.

items.prompt: Is there traceability from checklist-required coding rules to sections in the uploaded source document?

subchecks.text: Each required rule keyword appears in at least one locator-backed unit

items.acceptance_criteria: Full scan of extraction units; missing hits → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless explicitly contradicted.

items.prompt: Has external static-analysis / peer-review evidence been provided for coding-standard compliance?

subchecks.text: External evidence document linked in run meta

items.acceptance_criteria: Without uploaded external evidence → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (missing evidence ≠ NA).

items.prompt: Are project-specific deviations from the coding standard documented and approved?
items.applicability: Always requires human judgment for approval status.
items.acceptance_criteria: Engine proposes MANUAL_REVIEW; human decision is Phase 5.
